verdict.rationale: Mem0 ships an official MCP server that lets any MCP-capable client (Claude, Cursor, etc.) connect to the same shared memory store via a single hosted endpoint, plus documented plugins for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and other harnesses, and broad SDK/integration guides for 22+ tools. This directly supports the cross-tool shared-memory story with first-party docs and a probe confirming the MCP server exists. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation that memories set in one assistant (e.g. ChatGPT) are actually retrieved and used by another (e.g. Cursor) in practice, beyond vendor documentation.
